STANZA I
Up from my youth, may Israel say
Up from my youth, may Israel say,
Have I been nurs'd in tears;
My griefs were constant as the day,
And tedious as the years.
The psalm it sets
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 129, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth— let Israel now declare— 2many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me. 3The plowmen plowed over my back; they made their furrows long. 4The LORD is righteous; He has cut me from the cords of the wicked. … 4 more verses PSALM 129 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 129
